findings.title: Phase 3 two-week soak window elapsed with no gate assessment
findings.detail: Phase 3 'Dogfood / 2-week soak' started 2026-05-21. The plan.md §Phase 3 defines a 7–14 day window with four success criteria before Phase 6 (IFleet fold-in) can proceed: ≥5 findings closed end-to-end with Codex gate, ≥1 Codex catch Claude missed, zero phantom opens, splittasks MASTER.md surfaced findings correctly every session. As of 2026-06-21 (31 days elapsed), the 14-day max closed on 2026-06-04 with no recorded gate assessment. README.md still shows '🟡 in progress', leaving Phase 6 in an ambiguously blocked state.
findings.fix_sketch: Update Phase 3 status in the README.md status table to indicate the soak window elapsed and a gate assessment is due. Separately, Sebastian should evaluate the four criteria from plan.md §Phase 3 and update Phase 6 status accordingly.

findings.title: README.md as-of date 2026-06-02 is 19 days stale
findings.detail: Line 45 of README.md stated 'As of 2026-06-02: audit-elevation has 0 open findings'. The .audits/index.json confirms 0 open findings as of today (2026-06-21), but the embedded date creates a misleading claim that the status was last verified 19 days ago.
findings.fix_sketch: Update '2026-06-02' to '2026-06-21' in the status section.

findings.title: proposer-spec.md watch-list default hard-codes Mac-local paths
findings.detail: The Proposer spec §2 default watch-list JSON hard-codes Mac-local paths (~/dev/ai-products/IFleet, ~/dev/coordination/factory, etc.). If open decision D1 resolves to VPS hosting (options b or c), these paths won't resolve — IFleet on the VPS lives at /home/user/IFleet. No deployment note existed to warn implementers of this path dependency.
findings.fix_sketch: Add a deployment note after the watch-list JSON block flagging that paths must be updated when D1 resolves.
